# Your first scene

A scene is a generator function passed to `makeScene`. In `1.0.0` the function
receives a `view` — the root container every node is added to.

```tsx
import { makeScene, Circle, createRef } from 'motion-script';

export default makeScene(function* (view) {
  const dot = createRef<Circle>();

  view.add(<Circle ref={dot} size={120} fill="tomato" />);

  yield* dot().scale(2, 0.8);
});
```

## Running it

In `1.0.0` scenes were rendered with the standalone CLI:

```bash
motion-script render scene.tsx
```

This was later folded into the `ms` command.
